heading: Let's talk
invite: I work with companies that have a process they've been tolerating for too long. Outreach that should be smarter. Reports that take days instead of minutes. Knowledge buried in files nobody searches. If your team is doing something by hand that shouldn't need a human, I want to hear what it is.
openTo: Open to freelance projects, long-term retainers, and one-off builds. Any scale, any industry.
